verdict.rationale: A state business-filing authority could plausibly publish a documented public API (for example, for entity search or filings), so this axis applies. The evidence only shows robots.txt probes blocked by Akamai and Incapsula bot walls on both the front door and the ORION filing portal. Nothing in the pack documents a public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
